key_findings: Scripted ResearchBrain tool loop produced Stage-0 source-backed hypothesis artifacts only.
limitations: Deterministic fake/scripted agent slice; no live LLM, live web, WFA, MT5, or profitability validation.

claims_extracted: Order flow imbalance amplifies price movements in Treasury markets
Necessary to look beyond daily volumes and examine high-frequency intraday measures of liquidity demand and supply along with order flow imbalance
Intraday OFI disentangles effects that daily aggregates obscure
Session-level liquidity demand and supply interaction drives amplification of directional price moves
limitations: Source examines U.S. Treasury markets specifically, not FX or index instruments directly
No direct FTMO/MT5 or MQL5 validation provided
High-frequency intraday data used may not map directly to M15-H1 bar structure without further assumptions
disconfirming_relevance: Treasury-specific results may not generalize to FX majors or metals on FTMO/MT5
Government bond microstructure differs from retail CFD price formation on MT5
OFI construction requires trade-level or order-book data not natively available in MT5 OHLC bars

hypothesis_packets.mechanism: Session-concentrated order flow imbalance amplifies directional price movement during high-participation windows such as London open and NY overlap
hypothesis_packets.falsifiable_prediction: If intraday session volume concentration does not correlate with directional bar range expansion on M15-H1 bars across FTMO MT5 instruments the OFI amplification mechanism would be falsified for this context
hypothesis_packets.market_structure_assumption: FX and index CFD markets on MT5 exhibit session-dependent liquidity cycles where participation concentration at London open and NY overlap creates directional flow imbalance detectable via tick-volume proxies
hypothesis_packets.instrument_scope: FTMO MT5 FX majors EURUSD GBPUSD USDJPY and index CFDs US30 GER40 with XAUUSD as secondary scope
hypothesis_packets.required_data: M15 and H1 OHLCV bars for EURUSD GBPUSD USDJPY XAUUSD US30 GER40 covering at least 6 months from FTMO MT5 terminal with tick volume for session concentration analysis
hypothesis_packets.expected_holding_period: Intraday hours to less than one full session
hypothesis_packets.expected_trade_frequency: Unknown qualitatively a few candidate windows per session during high-participation overlaps
expected_failure_modes: Session overlap windows may not produce consistent directional imbalance on CFD instruments
MT5 tick volume is broker-side tick count not true traded volume and may fail to capture real OFI
Spread widening at session transitions may offset any directional signal detected
invalidation_criteria: No detectable relationship between session timing and bar range expansion across tested instruments
Tick volume concentration fails to discriminate high versus low participation windows on M15-H1 bars
MT5 server timezone offset causes session classification to misalign with actual London/NY liquidity windows
hypothesis_packets.implementation_shape: Classify M15-H1 bars by session window London open NY overlap and off-session; compute tick-volume-based directional imbalance proxy; flag bars with concentrated directional volume during overlap windows for directional bias candidacy
hypothesis_packets.execution_sensitivity: Spread widening at session opens and closes; swap costs for positions held across session boundaries; MT5 tick volume versus real traded volume discrepancy; commission structure at FTMO may erode signals at transitions
hypothesis_packets.mt5_ftmo_concerns: MT5 tick volume is broker-side tick count not exchange volume so OFI proxy is indirect; FTMO spread and commission structure may erode any session-transition edge; MT5 server timezone offset from GMT affects session window classification accuracy; requires terminal-backed instrument equivalence before validation
prior_related_lessons: Use only deterministic captured source artifacts as evidence; provider-native knowledge is not evidence
For live tool mode capture_url_source must include source_id url and source_class; the URL must be one returned by search_web in the same run

disconfirming_evidence: Source examines US Treasury markets specifically not FX or CFD instruments directly
